title: mergeSelectionOrder
description: Merges a previous ordered id list with a fresh selection: keeps prior order for still-selected nodes and appends newly selected ones.

params.name: prevIds
params.description: Previously ordered node ids (from drag-and-drop list).

params.name: incoming
params.description: Current selection items, each with at least an `id` field.

returns.description: Ordered array of selection item objects.
